_provenance.method: Each record's arxiv_id was resolved against the live arXiv entry. Where the id returned an unrelated paper, the correct id was found by title search and accepted only on an exact title match. Author strings follow the catalog convention: full surname sequence, 'et al.' only past ten names. `year` and `venue` are excluded: in this catalog they describe the publication venue, not the arXiv posting.
_provenance.scope: The 35 arXiv-backed records added by the v1.20.0 patch, plus structured-cot-code-generation from the existing baseline, which carried the only abbreviated author string outside the patch.
